title: Harden Backend Core Version Contract Consumption
stopConditions: Project Control cannot identify the Work path, owner repository, active role, checklist target, and evidence target before Backend product edits.
Backend product behavior would be edited before reading the Backend repository AGENTS.md in a dedicated Backend worktree.
Backend copies Core capability or retirement-inventory facts instead of consuming, wrapping, or verifying the Core-owned contract.
A copied Core version surface cannot be deleted or classified as retained for Backend response compatibility with a reason.
The lane would claim Backend production readiness, Editor readiness, or broad FlowDoc compatibility from a bounded consumer-hardening patch.
verificationTarget: Backend worktree evidence proves version capability reporting cannot drift from the Core-owned contract, preserves Backend revision/persistence ownership, classifies copied facts, and Project Control records the bounded result without broad truth promotion.
summary: Begin Backend consumer hardening for the Core version capability and retirement-inventory contract before further Backend service hardening.
